name: mysql-anon-user
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: creates an anonymous (blank-username) database account, as an unhardened MySQL/MariaDB ships. Paired check counts anonymous users. Best-effort (needs a running local server with socket root auth). No vars.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mysql -e "CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS ''@'localhost'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;" 2>/dev/null || \
mysql -e "INSERT IGNORE INTO mysql.user (Host,User) VALUES ('localhost',''); FLUSH PRIVILEGES;" 2>/dev/null || true
